verdict.rationale: Skyfire's MCP server and token APIs let an agent autonomously discover sellers, mint kya/pay tokens, and settle payments without human intervention in each step (skyfire-docs-6, skyfire-docs-31, skyfire-supp-9), which supports agent-driven background commerce loops. However there is no documented scheduler, trigger system, or persistent background job runner within Skyfire itself — the docs describe payment/identity infrastructure consumed by an external agent, not a native automation-scheduling capability. Missing for 10: evidence of Skyfire hosting or scheduling recurring/background tasks itself, and any first-party or independent account of an automation running unattended over time.
